decisions.editedPayload: Model leadership is now table stakes: the live contest is over who owns agents and defaults (Platform, clusters 2-6), who can secure the chips and power to deploy at scale (Infrastructure, clusters 7-9), and who captures the surplus as inference costs collapse (Economics, clusters 10-12) — while a fast-rising human-impact lens (clusters 13-15) asks who benefits and who is displaced, making public value the race's new scoreboard.
